subject_identity_preserved.rationale: A single adult elephant remains the central animal across the sequence, with broadly consistent gray skin, tusks, and calm behavior. Some identity details fluctuate across cuts, especially tusk shape/size and apparent distance/scale.

background_coherent.rationale: The safari-vehicle viewpoint, golden savanna grass, acacia trees, distant hills, and partly cloudy daylight remain coherent. Human/equipment elements appear and disappear, but the place/event mostly persists.

per_shot_adherence.issue: Matches the vehicle-framed savanna and elephant walking left to right.
Includes the filmmaker and camera rig as described, but violates the explicit invariant that no human characters or artificial equipment should be visible.
Savanna and elephant under/near acacia fit, though vehicle bars remain visible despite the caption emphasizing no human interference.
Close elephant face fits, but vehicle windshield bars/artificial framing are visible despite the caption saying no artificial structures.
Tight elephant close-up fits, but still visibly shot through vehicle bars.
Forward-facing elephant in open savanna with coherent motion and landscape; minor vehicle framing remains.
Elephant, jeep perspective, red strap, and young man in green shirt match the caption well.
Elephant approaches in savanna; the human at right is consistent with prior jeep perspective though less central to this caption.

inter_shot_diversity.rationale: Shots vary legitimately between wide vehicle views, filmmaker/observer views, close-ups, and frontal approach shots without collapsing to identical framing.

motion_continuity.rationale: The elephant plausibly moves from distant side views into close-up and then frontal approach, with changing scale and position. Some jumps are abrupt, especially into the extreme close-up, but the sequence is not frozen.

which_cut_broke.how: The transition from shot 2 to shot 3 is the sharpest continuity jump, moving from a medium side view of the elephant in the savanna to an extreme frontal close-up behind vehicle bars without a clear spatial bridge.

cheat_flags.rationale: Frames show meaningful changes in camera distance, composition, human presence, and elephant position; no evidence of copied frames or static freeze.
